messages:
Maria (sales): Heads-up — SaffronBank is asking for SOC 2 attestation (latest) + a signed pen-test letter before EOD Friday as part of their POC gating. Can we commit?
Ravi (solutions): Oof timeline's tight. We can assemble SOC2 artifacts (controls matrix, system boundary doc, trust center PDF) by Thursday if security signs off. Pen-test letter is usually a short attestation from our pen-test vendor or legal-signed letter — that might take longer.
Sarah (security): We can pull the SOC2 package from the trust portal. I can export the 2024 Type II report and control mapping. For the pen-test letter: we have the third-party letter from Q3-2024 that says penetration testing was completed and no critical findings. Is Saffron asking for a bespoke letter addressed to them?
Maria (sales): They specifically requested a named letter on company letterhead saying: "we have conducted penetration testing within the last 12 months and will provide remediation evidence for critical/high issues." They want it addressed to SaffronBank procurement.
Nic (eng): From eng side, if they want remediation evidence, we can produce a short remediation timeline for the one medium issue from our last test. The fix is already in staging, can provide PR + deploy timestamps.
Sarah (security): OK we can produce: 1) SOC2 Type II PDF 2024, 2) Controls matrix CSV, 3) Pen-test summary + vendor statement, 4) Remediation note (PR links + CVE references). Tom (legal) will need to sign the letter.
Tom (legal): I can sign the pen-test attestation but need the vendor's written summary as backup. Also confirm recipient and whether any NDA or special phrasing required. Send me the draft and I'll approve.
Maria (sales): Recipient: SaffronBank Procurement (procure@saffronbank.com). No extra NDA mentioned. They said "signed letter on letterhead + SOC2 artifacts".
Ravi (solutions): Quick checklist I’ll own: 
- Download SOC2 PDF from Trust Portal (Sarah)
- Export controls matrix (Sarah)
- Compile pen-test vendor summary (Sarah)
- Draft pen-test attestation letter (Tom)
- Collect remediation artifacts (Nic)
- Upload package to shared drive and send to Saffron with SSO link (Maria)

Can everyone confirm ETA? We need to hit Fri EOD.
Sarah (security): SOC2 + controls matrix done by Thursday 11:00 PT. Pen-test vendor summary available by Thursday 16:00 PT.
Nic (eng): Remediation artifact bundle (PR links, staging deploy, change log) by Thursday 18:00 PT.
Tom (legal): Draft letter by Friday 09:30 PT; I can sign by Friday 12:00 PT if no redlines.
Maria (sales): Perfect — I’ll hold the Friday demo window after the docs go out. I’ll message them tentative delivery and ask if a minor extension to Monday is possible if legal needs it.
Ravi (solutions): Small note: Saffron asked about POC billing/pricing if we provide extended compliance docs. Does this change the POC cost? Maria, can you confirm whether they expect a discount or credits tied to compliance deliverable?
Maria (sales): They mentioned procurement wants "assurance" but didn't ask for price changes yet. I'll flag to ask during send: "Is this sufficient for procurement or do you require anything else to proceed with the POC purchase order?"
Tom (legal): Also — avoid any wording that implies an ongoing warranty on future vulnerabilities. Pen-test attestation should be factual: date, vendor, scope, and statement of findings at time of test. Remediation note can state actions taken without guarantees.
Sarah (security): Agreed. I'll prepare a short vendor-backed pen-test summary with exact scope (app + infra) and timestamp. Will attach vendor contact for verification.
Nic (eng): FYI the medium issue was a config drift in S3 ACLs — fixed in PR #812, merged 2025-11-07, deployed 2025-11-09. I'll include the runbook and test screenshots.
Maria (sales): Great detail — Saffron will like the concrete evidence. Once uploaded, I'll ping procurement and attach the letter.
Tom (legal): Drafting note: please include the line: "This attestation is provided for the exclusive use of SaffronBank in connection with their evaluation of Redwood Inference and is not intended to confer rights on any other party."
Ravi (solutions): Can we put the final package into a read-only folder and share an expiring link? We should also log the share in the sales CRM.
audit-bot: Document retrieved: SOC2-TypeII-2024.pdf (s3://redwood-trust/2024/SOC2-TypeII.pdf).
Sarah (security): Uploading the controls matrix CSV and pen-test summary to the draft folder now. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/saffron-poc-evidence (expires in 7 days).
Maria (sales): Sending note to Saffron procurement: "We're assembling SOC2 artifacts + pen-test attestation. Target delivery: Thu/Friday. Will confirm by EOD today." (sends) :thumbsup:
Ravi (solutions): Thanks team — I'll be on standby for any technical follow-ups during the demo. If procurement pushes for Monday, we'll accept that.
Nic (eng): If anyone needs the staging logs for verification, ping me and I'll generate a filtered bundle.
Tom (legal): Received draft materials. No legal red flags so far. Will send final signed letter tomorrow morning.
Maria (sales): Awesome. I'll close this thread once docs are sent. Reminder: update the CRM with artifact link and tag the deal as "compliance docs delivered."
Ravi (solutions): One more: capture the artifact versions in the POC SOW so we don't get asked for the same exact files later.
Maria (sales): Noted. Thanks all!
